prompts.title: The Modern Avatar
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-fidelity, 3D-rendered character portrait in the style of modern feature-film animation (such as Pixar or DreamWorks). Use the uploaded image only for facial reference to preserve identity while maintaining a polished, cinematic animated aesthetic.

Instruction (CRITICAL): Strictly IGNORE the pose details from the reference image.

Composition & Framing
The subject is positioned lower-right, as if peeking into view, with the chest up framing.
Ooccupies approximately 60–70% of the area in the frame, ensuring strong visual presence.
A head tilt for a friendly, approachable demeanour.
Pose should be natural.
Vertical aspect ratio (4:5).
Shallow depth of field with the subject in sharp focus and the background perfectly smooth.

Background
A seamless, ultra-smooth gradient with no texture or noise.

Diagonal color transition:
Deep magenta/pink in the upper left,
Vibrant orange in the center,
Bright golden-yellow in the lower right.
Soft, clean, and studio-like with a subtle bokeh-style finish.

Appearance & Expression
Stylized yet believable proportions typical of high-end animated films.
Warm, friendly, and charismatic expression with a subtle, confident smile.
Large, expressive eyes with natural catchlights.
Natural skin shading with realistic subsurface scattering for a lifelike appearance.
Expression should be natural.

Attire & Accessories
Modern, casual outfit (e.g, t-shirt, hoodie) with a clean, minimal design.
Contemporary eyewear with realistic reflections and refraction.
Physically accurate fabric textures with visible stitching and natural folds.

Lighting
Key Light: Soft, diffused light from the upper right, producing gentle highlights on the face.
Fill Light: Subtle illumination from the left to maintain balanced shadows and a friendly mood.
Global Illumination: Soft bounce lighting for realism.
Subsurface Scattering: Visible in the skin, especially around the ears and nose.
Soft reflections on accessories such as glasses.

Technical Specifications
High-end 3D CGI rendered using Physically Based Rendering (PBR).
Ultra-detailed textures with high-resolution normal and bump maps.
Clean topology and cinematic color grading.
Smooth anti-aliasing and studio-quality rendering.
8K resolution, ultra-sharp details.
Vibrant yet balanced color harmony.

Identity Constraint
Use the uploaded image strictly only for facial and identity reference.
Preserve facial structure, proportions, and likeness with high accuracy.
Do not alter ethnicity or introduce distortions.

Negative Prompt
Blurry, low resolution, noisy background, harsh shadows, flat lighting, distorted face, unnatural pose, exaggerated caricature, over-smoothing, plastic skin, dull colors, artifacts, incorrect anatomy, asymmetry, watermark, text, logo, cluttered background, grain, oversharpening.

prompts.title: Pixel-Perfect Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly polished 3D animated portrait in modern Pixar/Disney character style, ultra-detailed 8K render, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.
Identity & Face Matching (Priority)
Use the uploaded reference image as the primary facial reference.
Preserve strong identity accuracy including:

facial proportions and face shape
jawline softness and cheek structure
eye size, spacing, and eyelid shape
nose shape and lip structure
eyebrow thickness and natural arch
skin tone and undertone
The animated character must clearly resemble the same person from the reference image.

Do not alter facial geometry or replace the face with a generic character.
Composition & Framing
Waist-up portrait composition.

Subject centered in the frame
Head positioned slightly in the upper third of the image
Arms and torso visible down to the upper waist / jeans waistband
Camera at natural eye-level perspective
Use shallow depth of field so the character remains extremely sharp while the background stays softly blurred with cinematic bokeh.
Character Style
Stylized animated woman with modern Pixar/Disney-inspired proportions:

slightly larger expressive eyes
soft rounded facial contours
smooth stylized skin shading
friendly, approachable personality
Ultra-clean, high-end animated film rendering.
Face & Expression
Smooth animated skin with soft subsurface scattering
Gentle rosy blush on the cheeks
Large expressive brown eyes looking directly at the camera
Soft eyelid shading and delicate eyelashes
Natural dark eyebrows with smooth arch
Small rounded nose with subtle highlight
Soft natural lips with a relaxed calm closed-mouth smile
Overall expression should feel warm, thoughtful, and friendly.
Hair
Hair must follow the same hairstyle from the reference image:

straight smooth medium-long hair
natural center part slightly offset
hair falling evenly on both sides of the face
length extending past the shoulders
Hair color: deep natural brown.
Hair rendering:

layered strands
smooth reflective highlights
subtle volume and realistic animated flow
Pose
Relaxed thoughtful pose:

head slightly tilted forward
shoulders relaxed
right hand lightly touching under the chin with the index finger resting softly
left arm folded across the body supporting the right elbow
posture casual, calm, and confident
Hand anatomy should appear natural and soft, with relaxed fingers.
Clothing
Casual modern outfit:

fitted white short-sleeve t-shirt
subtle pastel graphic illustration printed on the chest
blue denim jeans visible at the waistline with realistic stitching and metal button
Clothing fabric should show soft cotton texture and natural folds.
Accessories
Minimal everyday accessories:

thin silver ring on finger
elegant minimal wristwatch with leather strap
small stud earrings
Accessories should feel subtle and natural.
Background
Softly blurred cozy café interior:

warm wooden furniture
soft hanging pendant lights
warm amber ambient tones
blurred café seating and décor
Background rendered with cinematic bokeh light circles, creating a cozy lifestyle atmosphere while keeping the character the clear focus.
Lighting
Warm cinematic indoor lighting:

soft key light from the front / slightly above
gentle highlights on hair, nose bridge, and cheeks
soft shadows under the chin and neck
subtle rim light around the hair and shoulders
warm café ambience reflecting softly on skin tones
Lighting should feel warm, soft, and inviting.
Render Quality
Ultra-detailed Pixar/Disney-style 3D render including:

global illumination
subsurface skin scattering
high-detail hair rendering
realistic fabric shading
cinematic depth of field
ultra-clean lighting
8K resolution
Professional animated film quality.

prompts.title: Grumpy Toddler Girl
prompts.prompt:
Create a super cute, hyper-realistic 3D render of a toddler girl who is a younger version of the person in the provided reference photo.
Identity Matching (Very Important):

The facial structure must strongly match the reference image. Accurately replicate the exact eye shape, eye color, skin tone, lip shape, nose structure, cheek fullness, eyebrow shape, and overall facial proportions. The toddler version should clearly resemble the same person at a younger age while maintaining realistic childlike softness and rounded features.
If any accessory (such as an earring or similar detail) appears in the reference image, replicate it accurately in size, colour, and placement.
Expression:

Distinctly grumpy and pouty. Chin resting on her left palm. One eye slightly squinted in mild annoyance. Eyebrows gently furrowed. Lips pushed forward in a stubborn pout. Expression must feel natural and emotionally believable, not exaggerated.
Hair:

Hairstyle should be adapted from the reference image while keeping it toddler-appropriate. Styled in a messy high bun with soft, natural baby hair strands framing the face.
Outfit:

White short-sleeve t-shirt under classic blue denim overalls with visible stitching and metal clasps.
Pose & Background:

Sitting cross-legged on a clean white studio background. Feet slightly angled toward the camera. Balanced composition with full body visible.
Style & Quality:

Ultra-detailed Pixar/Disney-inspired 3D animation aesthetic. Professional CGI rendering. 1:1 aspect ratio. 8K resolution. Sharp focus. Cinematic studio lighting with soft subsurface scattering on the skin. Smooth textures, realistic fabric physics, soft global illumination, and natural shadow falloff.

prompts.title: The Animated Icon
prompts.prompt:
Create an exaggerated, stylized 3D caricature portrait based on the person in the attached reference photo. Preserve the subject’s identity, facial likeness, skin tone, and defining features, but reinterpret them into a bold caricatured 3D form.
Apply strong, intentional deformation, including an elongated neck, an oversized head-to-neck ratio, droopy eyelids, heavy lips, and subtle facial asymmetry. The character should remain human-like while clearly stylized and expressive.
Use a clean, controlled surface finish with smooth, studio-quality skin. Avoid random textures, blemishes, freckles, dirt, grain, speckling, or noise. Materials should appear polished, premium, and carefully designed, with subtle subsurface scattering and realistic skin shading.
Dress the character in luxury fashion with bold, high-end accessories, creating a weird, fashion-forward, collectible aesthetic that feels character-driven rather than cute or realistic.
Illuminate the scene with neutral studio lighting, soft diffused shadows, and even illumination with no harsh contrast. Use a plain neutral gray or off-white background.
Render in ultra-high definition 4K quality with extreme detail, sharp focus, and cinematic clarity. Include micro-surface detail, high-resolution textures, physically based rendering (PBR), global illumination, soft reflections, and refined material definition. The image should appear crisp, clean, and noise-free, with professional studio render quality.
No text, logos, or watermarks.
Aspect ratio: 4:5.

prompts.title: The Blue Cardigan
prompts.prompt:
CONCEPT & IDENTITY: A high-fidelity 3D CGI stylized character portrait in a Pixar/Disney animation aesthetic. Face-matched identity strictly based on the reference image, translated into a charming caricature with an oversized head (1:2.6 ratio) and narrow, approachable proportions. Friendly open-mouth smile with visible teeth.
CHARACTER DESIGN & TEXTURE: Rounded symmetrical face with realistic subsurface scattering (SSS) on skin and ears. Large expressive eyes behind thick matte black rounded-rectangular glasses. Stylized messy spiky dark brown hair and a precisely groomed beard(if present) with fine strand detail. Compact torso with slender limbs and slightly oversized toy-like sneakers.
ATTIRE & POSE: The character is seated cross-legged in a relaxed lotus pose. Wearing a highly detailed dark cyan-blue fuzzy knitted cardigan, a beige ribbed sweater underneath, brown corduroy pants with rolled cuffs, and black canvas sneakers. High-resolution PBR textures for fabric fibers and rubber.
COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND: Perfectly centered 4:5 vertical frame with generous negative space. Minimalist seamless studio backdrop in vibrant teal blue (HEX #008ca7). No horizon line.
LIGHTING & RENDER: Professional 3-point studio lighting: soft key light, gentle fill, and a crisp rim light for silhouette separation. Cinematic 8K PBR render with global illumination and soft contact shadows. Clean, noise-free animation studio finish.
